description: Defines the AttachmentsRepo class responsible for managing file attachments in an Android app, including writing, deleting, and retrieving URIs for stored files.

classes.name: AttachmentsRepo
classes.description: Manages storing, retrieving, and deleting attachment files in app's private storage.

methods.name: AttachmentsRepo
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and attachment directory.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Reads content from a URI, saves it as a file in private storage, and returns its URI.

methods.name: getAllUris
methods.description: Returns a list of URIs for all stored attachment files.

methods.name: getUriForFile
methods.description: Generates a content URI for a given file using FileProvider.
